items.statement: Koalas are a kind of bear.
items.explanation: Koalas are marsupials: they carry their babies in a pouch.

items.statement: A sloth can hold its breath longer than a dolphin.
items.explanation: Sloths slow their hearts and can hold their breath for about 40 minutes.

items.statement: A goldfish can only remember things for three seconds.
items.explanation: Goldfish remember things for months and can be trained to do tricks.
